blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: public key — A key that can be distributed openly.
private key — A matching secret key kept by its owner.
asymmetric encryption — Uses a related public/private key pair.
digital signature — Cryptographic evidence of origin and integrity with private-key signing.

blocks.title: Generate key pair
blocks.text: Public key can be shared; private key remains secret.

blocks.title: Encrypt to recipient
blocks.text: A message encrypted with recipient public key is decrypted by recipient private key.

blocks.title: Sign and verify
blocks.text: Signature created with private key is verified using corresponding public key.

blocks.title: Verify with public key
blocks.text: The publisher creates the digital signature with its private key. Users verify it with the public key obtained through a trusted route; this supports authenticity and integrity, not secrecy of the update.
